name: Illusory Dragon

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: A Huge shadow dragon appears in an empty space you can see within range; it can't be harmed or affected by conditions. Each enemy that sees it appear makes a Wisdom save or drops what it's holding and is Frightened; a Frightened creature repeats the save at the end of its turn only while it can't see the dragon. As a Bonus Action the dragon moves up to 60 feet and breathes a 60-foot Cone: creatures in it make an Intelligence save against 6d6 damage of the type you chose at casting (Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic or Poison), half on a success. (Seeing through the illusion with a Study isn't in the game.)
